subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek is a ghost whose mother named him after an actor, and whose father disliked the name, creating family friction; he was killed and dismembered by Buppido, and now seeks to have his bones taken to Blingdenstone; he wears an obsidian family ring on a lost hand.
source_quote: My mother named me after an actor. And well, there was always this doubt about the origin of the name and my lineage, which created a lot of friction in my family. And since you asked. I had a delightful childhood, except when it came to my name. My father was always very jealous, and there was always an undercurrent of hurt and shame in my name and how it affected my parents. I suppose that’s why I ended up as a merchant, and became friends with Buppido and ignored the tell-tale signs of his incipient murderous rampage.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido was a derro merchant who partnered with Pelek, worked with the Council of Savants, and claimed he could move product out of the city without dealing with the Duergar taxes; he became convinced he was a divine figure after the Faerzress glowed and then darkened.
source_quote: He was working with a faction of Derro known as the Council of Savants. Buppido said he could move product out of the city without dealing with the Duergar taxes. And well, he needed a supplier who could act. And well, you know, that tickled me pink. He promised to prove his point and brought me here.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is a cavernous hideout of the derro Buppido, scattered with bones and the remains of his dismembered partner Pelek; the walls contain a crack too small for passage, flanked by Pygmywort and Bigwig mushrooms; a thermal lake with black water lies to the northeast; a fungal thicket with hissing fungi blocks the eastern tunnel.
source_quote: The blood-spattered remains of Buppido lie scattered amongst the bones that made up the crazed Derro’s hideout. A crack in the wall, with mushrooms to either side of the crack. The crack is too small for anyone to fit into. A large pool filling the cavern ahead, stretching nearly one hundred feet to the opposite shore. The most striking feature of this pool is its unnervingly black water. A dense fungi forest. The path ahead vanishes into a thicket where the tallest specimens reach about five feet, creating a wall of fungal life that requires effort to pass through.

subject: the fungal thicket
fact: The fungal thicket east of the lake is a dense wall of fungi five feet tall, emitting a hissing sound from wind passing through perforated mushrooms; it contains Nightlights, barrelstalk, bluecap, ripplebark, trillimac, waterorb, zurkwhood, timmask, torchstalk, and swarms of centipedes.
source_quote: A hissing sound begins to rise. It sounds like uncounted tiny voices whispering in tongues he doesn't understand. ... Nightlights—mushrooms that grow to 15 feet and shed light in a 15-foot-by-15-foot circle. ... barrelstalk, a large, cask-shaped fungus that stores water, bluecap for making flour, ripplebark that tastes good toasted, trillimac that can be used for scrolls and makes a bread-like substance that can be rolled up, waterorb for storing water, and zurkwhood for making things. ... a two-foot-tall toadstool with orange and red stripes across its beige cap known as “the devil’s mushroom,” or a timmask. ... a two-foot-tall mushroom ... known as torchstalk. ... swarms of them.

subject: obsidian family ring
fact: An obsidian ring of value worn by Pelek on his lost hand; non-magical but potentially valuable; Pelek offers it as a reward if the hand is found.
source_quote: There is a family ring on it, an obsidian ring of some value. You can keep it if you find the hand.

subject: Pygmywort
fact: A mushroom with a one-inch-long stem and a stubby blue cap with white dots; when consumed, it causes a reduce spell effect, shrinking the consumer.
source_quote: Pygmywort is the mushroom with a one-inch-long stem and a stubby blue cap with white dots, and Bigwig is the four-inch-tall mushroom with a thin stem and a wide purple cap. The first one shrinks you, like the effect of a reduce spell, and the latter grows you, like the effect of an enlarge spell.

subject: Bigwig
fact: A mushroom with a four-inch-tall stem and a wide purple cap; when consumed, it causes an enlarge spell effect, growing the consumer.
source_quote: Pygmywort is the mushroom with a one-inch-long stem and a stubby blue cap with white dots, and Bigwig is the four-inch-tall mushroom with a thin stem and a wide purple cap. The first one shrinks you, like the effect of a reduce spell, and the latter grows you, like the effect of an enlarge spell.

subject: torchstalk
fact: A two-foot-tall mushroom with a combustible cap that can burn for 24 hours when lit.
source_quote: Why, that’s a torchstalk. It has a combustible cap and can burn for 24 hours when lit.

subject: timmask
fact: A two-foot-tall toadstool with orange and red stripes across its beige cap; uprooting it causes madness.
source_quote: A two-foot-tall toadstool with orange and red stripes across its beige cap known as “the devil’s mushroom,” or a timmask. Uprooting the mushroom can cause madness.

subject: the thermal lake
fact: A vast underground lake stretching nearly one hundred feet across, with unnervingly black, opaque water heated by a thermal spring; Daz froze it with magic to allow passage.
source_quote: A large pool filling the cavern ahead, stretching nearly one hundred feet to the opposite shore. The most striking feature of this pool is its unnervingly black water. ... the water is surprisingly heated by a thermal spring, making it pleasantly warm to his touch.

subject: Council of Savants
fact: A faction of derro led by Buppido, involved in smuggling goods out of the city to avoid Duergar taxes; Pelek was their supplier; Droki is a messenger for them.
source_quote: He was working with a faction of Derro known as the Council of Savants. ... The derro messenger? No. I was told that he works for the Council of Savants.

subject: Duergar
fact: A subterranean dwarf race that imposes taxes on trade in the Underdark; Buppido claimed he could bypass their levies.
source_quote: Buppido said he could move product out of the city without dealing with the Duergar taxes.

subject: centipedes
fact: Swarms of centipedes that emerge in the fungal thicket; resistant to Toll the Dead and Tasha's Caustic Brew; they swarm over Zalthir and cause deep unease in Daz.
source_quote: swarms of them. ... Daz watches as the centipedes emerge, a shiver running down his spine. ... the centipedes somehow manage to avoid the brunt of the spell.

subject: Droki
fact: A derro messenger for the Council of Savants; known for being peculiar and possibly mad; leaves a clear trail through the caverns, leading to a crack in the wall and through the fungal thicket.
source_quote: The derro messenger? No. I was told that he works for the Council of Savants. He’s very peculiar. Some say he’s mad. ... the obvious trail of Droki. ... Droki’s obvious trail. ... Droki’s trail is on the other side of the lake.

subject: the crack in the wall
fact: A narrow fissure in the cavern wall, flanked by Pygmywort and Bigwig mushrooms; too small for passage; Pelek’s ghost can see through it and reports a tiny tunnel.
source_quote: A crack in the wall, with mushrooms to either side of the crack. The crack is too small for anyone to fit into. ... A tiny tunnel. Tiny all the way through.

subject: the northern cavern
fact: A cavern accessed from Grygum, containing Droki’s trail and the crack in the wall; Zalthir investigates it after abandoning the ghostly dialogue.
source_quote: To the north is another cave and the obvious trail of Droki. ... Zalthir walks into the northern cavern and sees Droki’s obvious trail.

subject: Faerzress blink
fact: A phenomenon where the Faerzress glowed brightly, then darkened, and returned brighter than before; coincided with Buppido’s descent into divine delusion and Pelek’s death; suspected to have disrupted planar boundaries.
source_quote: I did notice that the Faerzress glowed brightly, and after that, Buppido’s temperament changed. He became convinced he was some kind of divine figure. ... It was almost as if it was being sucked out, and went dark and then came back brighter than before.

subject: Daz freezes the lake
fact: Daz casts a spell to freeze the thermal black lake, allowing the party to cross it by stepping on blocks of ice; his performance is met with silence except for Thorin’s slap and Grygum’s awe.
source_quote: He casts a spell with a flourish, and the water freezes. He turns to his friends, “Well, come on!” ... They stare at him and quickly jump on the ice. He then proceeds to cast another block of ice, and they jump from block to block, eventually landing on the other side of the lake.

subject: Grygum swallows Pygmywort
fact: Grygum impulsively consumes a Pygmywort mushroom, shrinking himself; he is unable to squeeze through the crack despite his reduced size.
source_quote: Grygum impulsively swallows a Pygmywort and shrinks. Unfortunately, he can’t squeeze through the crack.

subject: Pelek’s ghost merges into the rock
fact: Pelek’s ghost merges into the rock to peer through the crack in the wall and reports seeing a tunnel; he identifies the mushrooms on either side.
source_quote: The ghost sighs, “A tiny tunnel. Tiny all the way through.” Then the ghost pauses, “Oh, look at that Pygmywort and Bigwig.”

subject: Thorin confronts Pelek
fact: Thorin confronts Pelek for offering no reward for retrieving his bones; demands to know if the ring is magical; receives a sarcastic response and is told to avoid references to Lolth, Menzoberranzan, the number eight, and spiders.
source_quote: Is the ring magical? ... No. But if I said otherwise, would it encourage you more? ... make sure to deny any association to Lolth, or Menzoberranzan, and make any references to the number eight or spiders.

subject: Daz fails Toll the Dead
fact: Daz casts Toll the Dead on a swarm of centipedes; the spell fails completely; the centipedes remain unfazed and begin swarming Zalthir.
source_quote: Toll the Dead," he mutters, focusing his magical energy. He watches intently as the spell is cast, but his hope quickly fades as the centipedes seem unfazed. ... "No!" Daz exclaimed inwardly, "They saved!"

subject: Grygum casts Tasha's Caustic Brew
fact: Grygum casts Tasha's Caustic Brew on the centipede swarm; the spell fails to affect them significantly; Daz questions their luck or divine protection.
source_quote: Grygum then steps up, casting "Tasha's Caustic Brew." Daz watches with anticipation, but once again, the centipedes somehow manage to avoid the brunt of the spell. "Seriously?" Daz mutters under his breath.

subject: Pelek laughs at 'Overbrighters'
fact: Pelek repeatedly uses the term 'Overbrighters' to dismiss the party’s concerns; his laughter and condescension irritate Thorin and unnerves Daz.
source_quote: The ghost laughs. “Overbrighters.” ... The ghost then, as politely and contemptuously as possible, says, “Overbrighters.”

subject: Blingdenstone
fact: A gnomish city in the Underdark; Pelek’s goal is to have his bones transported there; it is described as the party’s exit route to the Overbrite.
source_quote: I need a favor.” The ghosts floats over some bones and points at them, “These bones are my bones, and I would appreciate you folks collecting my bones and bringing them to Blingdenstone.” ... The city of Blingdenstone is your exit.

subject: the Overbrite
fact: A region beyond Blingdenstone; Pelek says it is the party’s exit from the Underdark; access requires avoiding references to Lolth, Menzoberranzan, the number eight, and spiders.
source_quote: The city of Blingdenstone is your exit. There are many routes to the Overbrite from there. And to help you a little bit, when you get there, make sure to deny any association to Lolth, or Menzoberranzan, and make any references to the number eight or spiders.

subject: the whorlstone tunnels
fact: A network of tunnels referenced by Buppido as a route used by derro; Pelek mentions them as part of the derro’s smuggling paths.
source_quote: Buppido mentioned that there were tunnels that the derro used to go through the whorlstone tunnels.

subject: Nightlights
fact: Mushrooms growing up to 15 feet tall that emit light in a 15x15-foot circle; they stop glowing when touched or cut.
source_quote: Nightlights—mushrooms that grow to 15 feet and shed light in a 15-foot-by-15-foot circle. When they are touched or cut, they stop glowing.

subject: barrelstalk
fact: A large, cask-shaped fungus that stores water; collected by Daz as a potential resource.
source_quote: barrelstalk, a large, cask-shaped fungus that stores water

subject: bluecap
fact: A mushroom used for making flour; collected by Daz.
source_quote: bluecap for making flour

subject: ripplebark
fact: A mushroom that tastes good toasted; collected by Daz.
source_quote: ripplebark that tastes good toasted

subject: trillimac
fact: A mushroom that can be used for scrolls and makes a bread-like substance that can be rolled up; collected by Daz.
source_quote: trillimac that can be used for scrolls and makes a bread-like substance that can be rolled up

subject: waterorb
fact: A mushroom used for storing water; collected by Daz.
source_quote: waterorb for storing water

subject: zurkwhood
fact: A mushroom used for making things; collected by Daz.
source_quote: zurkwhood for making things

subject: Daz picks fungi
fact: Daz collects multiple types of Underdark fungi including barrelstalk, bluecap, ripplebark, trillimac, waterorb, and zurkwhood as potential resources.
source_quote: He picks up some barrelstalk, a large, cask-shaped fungus that stores water, bluecap for making flour, ripplebark that tastes good toasted, trillimac that can be used for scrolls and makes a bread-like substance that can be rolled up, waterorb for storing water, and zurkwhood for making things.

subject: Zalthir stumbles over monastic teachings
fact: Zalthir is mentally overwhelmed by the party’s banter and cannot recall his monastic order’s vague teachings, which were meant to refocus his attention.
source_quote: he stumbles, unable to remember the appropriately vague and incomprehensible teaching of his monastic order to refocus his attention after enduring the endless banter between the ghost, the dwarf, and the orc.

subject: Thorin smashes the wall
fact: Thorin declares he will smash through the crack in the wall, but Zalthir stops him, insisting on silence due to nearby enemies.
source_quote: Thorin marches past Zalthir, ‘I am going to smash our way through.” Zalthir stops him. He thinks, “We must be quiet. There are many enemies about.”

subject: Pelek’s head flops off
fact: Pelek’s ghostly head repeatedly flops off his neck; he apologizes and reattaches it each time, a recurring physical trait.
source_quote: He sighs apologetically, puts his head back on his neck, and continues, ... his head flops off. ... puts his head back on.

subject: Daz asks about Faerzress
fact: Daz speculates aloud that the Faerzress blinking may have broken planar walls, prompting Pelek to dismiss it as a ghost story.
source_quote: Then if it blinked, could it have - I dunno - broken the walls between the planes? ... That sounds like a ghost story. The Faerzress blinked, and then monsters from the Abyss appeared.

subject: Thorin takes mental notes
fact: Thorin documents Pelek’s claims about the Faerzress and the Underdark’s changes, concluding that the ghost has offered no useful information and demands better cooperation.
source_quote: He takes mental notes: "He’s confirmed that something weird has happened in the Underdark, and that it’s connected to the Faerzress. But I knew that. And it’s not like he’s given us any useful information. Time for this to change.”

subject: Daz tries to scare Pelek
fact: Daz attempts to scare Pelek with a frightening expression, but it only works on his younger siblings, not on a murdered ghost.
source_quote: Daz tries to scare him, but that scary face works better with his younger siblings than with a murdered ghost.

subject: Grygum says 'Wow!'
fact: After Daz freezes the lake, Grygum repeatedly says 'Wow!' in awe, contrasting with Zalthir’s silence and Thorin’s only physical acknowledgment.
source_quote: Grygum can’t stop saying “Wow!”

subject: Zalthir reflects on ormu
fact: Zalthir compares Nightlights unfavorably to ormu, a mushroom that can be crushed into a paste for light, lamenting the inefficiency of the former.
source_quote: It is so unlike the ormu,” he reflects on silently. “That can be crushed into a paste and used as a light source. Not the Nightlight.

subject: Pelek explains his family history
fact: Pelek recounts his family’s conflict over his name, his mother’s choice of naming him after an actor, his father’s jealousy, and how this shaped his path to becoming a merchant and friend to Buppido.
source_quote: My mother named me after an actor. And well, there was always this doubt about the origin of the name and my lineage, which created a lot of friction in my family. And since you asked. I had a delightful childhood, except when it came to my name. My father was always very jealous, and there was always an undercurrent of hurt and shame in my name and how it affected my parents. I suppose that’s why I ended up as a merchant, and became friends with Buppido and ignored the tell-tale signs of his incipient murderous rampage.

subject: Thorin demands cooperation
fact: Thorin shouts at Pelek, demanding to know if they can work together and if he will help collect his bones, after the ghost has made no offer of aid.
source_quote: Now, can we work together, and will you collect my bones?

subject: Pelek floats over bones
fact: Pelek’s ghost floats over his own dismembered remains and points to them, requesting they be collected and taken to Blingdenstone.
source_quote: The ghosts floats over some bones and points at them, “These bones are my bones, and I would appreciate you folks collecting my bones and bringing them to Blingdenstone.”

subject: Daz collects fungi for food
fact: Daz, trained in Underdark flora, identifies and collects multiple edible and magical fungi as provisions for the journey.
source_quote: Food for later," he mutters and pulls out his blade. He picks up some barrelstalk, a large, cask-shaped fungus that stores water, bluecap for making flour, ripplebark that tastes good toasted, trillimac that can be used for scrolls and makes a bread-like substance that can be rolled up, waterorb for storing water, and zurkwhood for making things.

subject: Zalthir throws punches at centipedes
fact: Zalthir reacts to the centipede swarm by throwing punches at them, which Daz perceives as brave or reckless.
source_quote: Zalthir is quick to act, throwing punches at one of the swarms. "Brave," Daz thinks, "or reckless."

subject: Daz fails to cast Toll the Dead
fact: Daz casts Toll the Dead on centipedes, but the spell fails; the centipedes save against it and swarm Zalthir.
source_quote: Toll the Dead," he mutters, focusing his magical energy. He watches intently as the spell is cast, but his hope quickly fades as the centipedes seem unfazed. ... "No!" Daz exclaimed inwardly, "They saved!"

subject: Pelek’s name origin ambiguity
fact: Pelek’s name’s origin is uncertain, tied to an actor he never met, and his family’s doubts about his lineage created lasting emotional conflict.
source_quote: There was always this doubt about the origin of the name and my lineage, which created a lot of friction in my family.

subject: Pelek mentions his childhood
fact: Pelek describes his childhood as delightful except for the emotional turmoil surrounding his name and his father’s jealousy.
source_quote: I had a delightful childhood, except when it came to my name. My father was always very jealous, and there was always an undercurrent of hurt and shame in my name and how it affected my parents.

subject: Pelek becomes a merchant
fact: Pelek became a merchant and befriended Buppido due to family conflict and emotional neglect tied to his name.
source_quote: I suppose that’s why I ended up as a merchant, and became friends with Buppido and ignored the tell-tale signs of his incipient murderous rampage.

subject: Thorin sighs at Pelek
fact: Thorin sighs repeatedly in frustration at Pelek’s lack of utility and his bizarre, self-absorbed storytelling.
source_quote: Thorin sighs, “Classic Buppido.” ... Thorin sighs. ... Thorin growls, ... Thorin mutters, ...

subject: Pelek says he likes the party
fact: Pelek tells the party he likes them and does not wish to possess them, calling possession awkward.
source_quote: Look, I don’t want to possess you. It’s awkward. And frankly, I like you.

subject: Daz smiles after freezing the lake
fact: Daz smiles after successfully freezing the lake, expecting applause, but receives none except for Thorin’s slap on the back.
source_quote: As they land safely, he smiles. And he waits for polite applause. There is none, but Thorin slaps his back.

subject: Zalthir is quiet
fact: Zalthir remains silent throughout the party’s interactions with Pelek and Daz’s actions, offering no commentary.
source_quote: As for Zalthir, Zalthir is quiet.

subject: Pelek says he doesn’t know how long he’s been dead
fact: Pelek admits he cannot accurately measure time since his death, as ghosts lack normal time markers and are confined to 30 feet from his bones.
source_quote: I don’t know,” he shrugs his shoulders, and his head flops off. He sighs apologetically, puts his head back on his neck, and continues, “Less than a year? Telling time in this cavern is hard. And being unable to move more than 30 feet from your bones makes it harder. And as a ghost, the usual time markers don’t apply.

subject: Pelek says he is fixated on stopping being a ghost
fact: Pelek admits to Thorin that his primary obsession as a ghost is to stop being one, making his struggle harder.
source_quote: And when you are a ghost, it’s a bit harder, what with my fixation on stopping being a ghost?

subject: Pelek says he was surprised he died
fact: Pelek expresses surprise at his own death, implying he did not expect to be killed by Buppido.
source_quote: I was surprised.

subject: Pelek says he was tickled pink
fact: Pelek describes his initial reaction to Buppido’s smuggling scheme as being “tickled pink,” indicating he was amused and eager to participate.
source_quote: And well, you know, that tickled me pink.

subject: Daz says ‘It is my time!’
fact: Daz declares dramatically, “It is my time!” before freezing the lake, signaling his intent to take decisive action.
source_quote: “It is my time!” announces Daz.

subject: Grygum asks about Pelek’s name
fact: Grygum asks Pelek what his name means, prompting the ghost to recount his entire family history and origin story.
source_quote: What does that name mean?

subject: Thorin asks how to avoid the number eight
fact: Thorin asks Pelek how to avoid the number eight, and Pelek replies with a simple directive: don’t have anything on your person that counts to eight.
source_quote: How do you avoid the number eight? ... Just don’t have anything on your person that counts - obviously - to eight.

subject: Pelek says he is delighted by Thorin’s ‘Classic Buppido’
fact: Pelek laughs in delight when Thorin says ‘Classic Buppido,’ indicating he recognizes and enjoys the dwarf’s dry humor.
source_quote: Thorin sighs, “Classic Buppido.” The ghost is delighted, “Yes! He killed me and cut my body up into the pieces you see here.”

subject: Daz notices the hissing sound
fact: Daz is unnerved by the hissing sound from the fungal thicket, despite Pelek’s dismissal of it as normal wind.
source_quote: Daz is unnerved by the auditory experience caused by air simply whistling through perforated mushrooms within the thicket, and let’s Thorin lead on.

subject: Zalthir wonders about monastic silence spells
fact: Zalthir reflects on his monastic training, wishing he had learned spells to make people silent rather than blind.
source_quote: Zalthir wonders why a monastic order devoted to silence only taught him how to make people blind, and not how to make them silent.

subject: Pelek says he was a supplier
fact: Pelek identifies himself as Buppido’s supplier, essential to the smuggling operation despite his death.
source_quote: He needed a supplier who could act. And well, you know, that tickled me pink.

subject: Pelek says he was stuck
fact: Pelek says he has been stuck in Grygum since his death, unable to move beyond 30 feet from his bones.
source_quote: And I have been stuck here ever since.

subject: Pelek says he was killed and dismembered
fact: Pelek confirms that Buppido killed him and cut his body into pieces, which now lie scattered in the cavern.
source_quote: He killed me and cut my body up into the pieces you see here.

subject: Daz picks Nightlights
fact: Daz observes and identifies Nightlights, noting their light properties and that they extinguish when touched.
source_quote: Daz notices that the thicket is full of mushrooms. ... Nightlights—mushrooms that grow to 15 feet and shed light in a 15-foot-by-15-foot circle. When they are touched or cut, they stop glowing.

subject: Daz warns about timmask
fact: Daz warns Thorin about the timmask mushroom, recalling its madness-inducing effect from past experience.
source_quote: Watch out," he shouts to Thorin. The dwarf was close to a two-foot-tall toadstool with orange and red stripes across its beige cap known as “the devil’s mushroom,” or a timmask. Uprooting the mushroom can cause madness. An effect he remembers all too well.

subject: Daz identifies torchstalk
fact: Daz identifies the torchstalk mushroom and explains its 24-hour burn time to Zalthir.
source_quote: Zalthir asks about a two-foot-tall mushroom, and Daz smiles, “Why, that’s a torchstalk. It has a combustible cap and can burn for 24 hours when lit.”

subject: Pelek says he is a merchant
fact: Pelek states that he became a merchant after his family conflict, and that this led him to partner with Buppido.
source_quote: I suppose that’s why I ended up as a merchant, and became friends with Buppido...

subject: Grygum shrinks
fact: Grygum consumes Pygmywort and shrinks, but cannot fit through the crack, rendering his action useless.
source_quote: Grygum impulsively swallows a Pygmywort and shrinks. Unfortunately, he can’t squeeze through the crack.

subject: Pelek says the Faerzress is unknown
fact: Pelek admits that no one knows what the Faerzress is, and he assumed its glow was just part of the Underdark’s nature.
source_quote: No one knows what the Faerzress is. And so I assumed it was something that happens.

subject: Daz says the Faerzress makes teleportation impossible
fact: Daz states that the Faerzress is a substance that makes teleportation into a region impossible, prompting speculation about planar breaches.
source_quote: So the Faerzress is a substance that makes teleportation into a region impossible.

subject: Pelek says he is a ghost
fact: Pelek repeatedly acknowledges his state as a ghost, describing his limitations and frustrations.
source_quote: And as a ghost, the usual time markers don’t apply." ... "I don’t want to possess you. It’s awkward.

source_quote: He killed me and cut my body up into the pieces you see here.

subject: Daz notices the hissing sound
fact: Daz is unnerved by the hissing sound from the fungal thicket, despite Pelek’s dismissal of it as normal wind.
source_quote: Daz is unnerved by the auditory experience caused by air simply whistling through perforated mushrooms within the thicket, and let’s Thorin lead on.

subject: Zalthir wonders about monastic silence spells
fact: Zalthir reflects on his monastic training, wishing he had learned spells to make people silent rather than blind.
source_quote: Zalthir wonders why a monastic order devoted to silence only taught him how to make people blind, and not how to make them silent.

subject: Daz says ‘It is my time!’
fact: Daz declares dramatically, “It is my time!” before freezing the lake, signaling his intent to take decisive action.
source_quote: “It is my time!” announces Daz.

subject: Grygum asks about Pelek’s name
fact: Grygum asks Pelek what his name means, prompting the ghost to recount his entire family history and origin story.
source_quote: What does that name mean?

subject: Thorin asks how to avoid the number eight
fact: Thorin asks Pelek how to avoid the number eight, and Pelek replies with a simple directive: don’t have anything on your person that counts to eight.
source_quote: How do you avoid the number eight? ... Just don’t have anything on your person that counts - obviously - to eight.

subject: Pelek says he is delighted by Thorin’s ‘Classic Buppido’
fact: Pelek laughs in delight when Thorin says ‘Classic Buppido,’ indicating he recognizes and enjoys the dwarf’s dry humor.
source_quote: Thorin sighs, “Classic Buppido.” The ghost is delighted, “Yes! He killed me and cut my body up into the pieces you see here.”

subject: Daz says the Faerzress makes teleportation impossible
fact: Daz states that the Faerzress is a substance that makes teleportation into a region impossible, prompting speculation about planar breaches.
